up: Return a list of approved drugs that have a COVID-19 indication. Include the drug name (pref_name), the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the MeSH heading (mesh_heading), and the EFO term (efo_term). An approved drug is defined as a molecule with max_phase = 4. The indication is identified by the MeSH heading containing the text 'COVID-19' (case-insensitive match).
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name, md.chembl_id, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN drug_indication di ON md.molregno = di.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND (di.mesh_heading LIKE '%COVID-19%' OR UPPER(di.mesh_heading) LIKE '%COVID-19%');
